title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
abstract: arXiv:2611.28748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. translated_title: 超越单轮隐私：对话式RAG中的训练数据泄露
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已被证明可以在单轮交互中减少训练数据泄露，但这种保护在多轮对话中是否持续有效尚不清楚。我们提出了CRELT（对话式RAG提取泄露轨迹），这是一个可复用的框架，能够逐轮追踪RAG系统泄露的训练数据中的真实联系信息。CRELT通过全因子设计将检索、对话历史和攻击策略三个因素分离，使用经核实不含目标个人身份信息（PII）的检索语料库，并且只有当某项信息在其被生成的轮次中不存在于模型输入时才将其计为泄露。在主要实验中，该判定标准排除了29-53%原本已存在于输入中的原始匹配项。在GPT-J-6B、Pythia-6.9B和Pythia-12B三个模型上，针对真实的安然公司（Enron）联系信息进行测试，结果表明无论在保留完整历史还是清空历史的情况下，检索都能减少训练数据的披露，这与先前的单轮研究结果一致。
tldr: 该论文提出CRELT框架首次系统性地逐轮追踪多轮对话中RAG系统的训练数据泄露情况，并发现在多轮对话中检索机制仍能持续减少训练数据的泄露，将单轮隐私保护的有效性延伸到了对话场景。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CRELT, a reusable framework that systematically tracks training-data leakage turn by turn in multi-turn RAG conversations, demonstrating that retrieval consistently reduces disclosure of memorized data across multiple turns, extending single-turn privacy protections to conversational settings.
